The '''Meria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsectors]] area of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system shared its name with the items known as [[Merian tricorn hoof|Merian tricorn hooves]], which were believed to be fake by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="Honor Among Thieves">''[[Honor Among Thieves]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Meria system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square H-15.<ref name="EAOC" />
